fed.note: FOMC held the target range steady; dissenters Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack both wanted a 25bp hike. Chair Warsh called inflation "elevated" and said the Fed will cut the number of rate-setting meetings starting 2027. No new decision since (next meeting 9-10 Dec). No FOMC meeting fell in the last 7 days, so this block is carried forward unchanged. The 10Y eased to 5.10% on 17 Nov from 5.12% on 16 Nov, pulling back further from the 5.15% high on 13 Nov.

catalysts.name: Ecolab Inc.
catalysts.what: Wells Fargo (analyst Jason Haas) upgraded Ecolab to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $380 from $315 on 13 Nov, about 26% above today's $300.68 price - citing AI data-center build-outs driving Ecolab's high-tech water/hygiene business and pricing surcharges persisting into FY2027. Street consensus is more measured (~$332-333 average target per one report vs earlier October desk targets of UBS $357 / JPM $310 / Citi $345 / BofA $355), so this is one bullish desk's target, not a reconciled consensus. Shares are little changed today (-0.6%) with the broader market selloff.

catalysts.name: NIQ Global Intelligence Plc
catalysts.what: NIQ beat Q3 2026 estimates (adjusted EPS $0.30 vs $0.23 consensus; revenue $1.12B, +6.3% y/y) and raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.16-$1.20 from $1.08-$1.12, its first GAAP-profitable quarter since its July 2025 IPO. The stock had already run up sharply (+54% since August) into the print, a risk flagged at the time; shares are now $17.38 (-5.2% today), extending their pullback amid the broad market selloff. No confirmed day-of closing-tape reaction is available to this routine (no OHLC access).

catalysts.name: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co.
catalysts.what: Barclays upgraded Reliance Steel & Aluminum (metals distributor) to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $507 from $445 - about 20.8% above today's $419.74 price. Shares are little changed today (-0.1%), tracking the broad market selloff rather than reversing the catalyst itself. Consensus elsewhere is more mixed (Hold rating, ~$415 average target), so this is one bullish desk, not a reconciled consensus upgrade.
